name: zerogpu-mcp-repo
description: ZeroGPU MCP server and agent plugins for offloading low-cost AI tasks to small/nano models.

scripts.build: npm --prefix mcp-server run build && npm --prefix openclaw-plugin/plugin run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix mcp-server run worker:types && npm --prefix openclaw-plugin/plugin run build
scripts.package:check: cd mcp-server && npm pack --dry-run && cd ../openclaw-plugin/plugin && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run package:check
